purpose: P0-Q qualification of a post-result NF-kB oscillatory-mode observability candidate; not confirmation

candidate_definition.modal_rule: Use the unique non-real complex-conjugate eigenpair in the complete six-mode local generator. If exactly one conjugate pair is not present, refuse.
candidate_definition.generator_scalar: chi_gen = -Re(lambda)/abs(lambda) for a stable complex-conjugate pair only
candidate_definition.observable_selection_basis: Publication-native central measured/represented NF-kB response variable and explicit frozen trajectory output; not selected by fit quality.
candidate_definition.fit_start_rule: First local minimum in free nuclear NF-kappaB after TNF onset.

qualification_criteria.note: These thresholds were calibrated after viewing the Figure 8A qualification case. They are P0-Q criteria only and cannot be represented as prospective confirmation.

known_bad_requirement.fixture: monotone single-exponential return sampled on the real trajectory times
known_bad_requirement.expected: must fail the oscillatory observability gate

admission_ceiling.allowed_if_pass: Candidate is qualified to face a separately frozen independent test. Figure 8A remains qualification evidence.
